summaries.Romania: Romania faces a critical energy crisis as both reactors at Cernavodă shut down due to low Danube levels, forcing emergency appeals for reduced consumption and threatening significant price hikes. Political instability continues to plague government formation with Fitch's rating decision looming Friday and healthcare workers striking over salary disputes.
summaries.Healthcare: The FTC is cracking down on telehealth company Hims & Hers for privacy violations and deceptive practices, while Medicare drug subsidies end and hospitals face growing pressure from AI implementation costs and supply chain inflation. Healthcare innovation continues with AI-powered diagnostic tools and virtual addiction treatment showing promising results.
summaries.Tech: Microsoft and Meta are aggressively competing with homegrown AI models and personal agent strategies, while Apple faces regulatory pressure on App Store policies and chip supply constraints from Qualcomm. The US government expanded bans on foreign robots and drones, and OpenAI confirmed plans for a family of AI devices.

items.title: Industria românească de IT simte efectele AI: valuri de concedieri, salarii înghețate și șanse puține pentru juniori. „Se înlocuiesc meserii în sine”
items.snippet: După mai bine de 20 de ani în care companiile de IT au tot făcut angajări în România, lucrurile s-au schimbat total. Perioada este dificilă, în ultimii doi ani au fost concediați mii de angajați, iar salariile și-au oprit creșterea, spun mai multe instituții și firme, în dialogul cu HotNews. Aproape
items.line: Romania's IT sector is experiencing unprecedented crisis with mass layoffs and frozen salaries as AI disruption reshapes the industry after 20+ years of consistent hiring growth.

items.title: BREAKING | Centrala de la Cernavodă, oprită integral din cauza debitului scăzut al Dunării: Este pentru prima dată când ambele reactoare sunt oprite voluntar și preventiv / Unitatea 2 se deconectează în această seară sau joi dimineață
items.snippet: Centrala de la Cernavodă va fi oprită integral joi, 30 iulie, după ce și Unitatea 2 va fi deconectată de la SEN joi, 30 iulie, începând cu ora 10:00, în contextul evoluției nefavorabile a condițiilor hidrologice de pe Dunăre, anunță ministerul Energiei. Unitatea 1 fusese oprită controlat pe 28 iulie
items.line: Complete shutdown of Cernavodă nuclear plant due to historic Danube water levels forces Romania to import energy and face significantly higher electricity costs during summer heat wave.

items.title: Fitch decide vineri dacă va retrograda ratingul României la categoria junk. Negrescu: „Agenția are câteva variante pe masă”
items.snippet: Agenţia Fitch urmează să anunţe, vineri noaptea, dacă va retrograda ratingul României la categoria junk, „o decizie pe muchie de cuţit având în vedere criza politică”, a transmis miercuri consultantul financiar, Adrian Negrescu. În opinia sa, Fitch are câteva variante pe masă.
items.line: Fitch's decision Friday on downgrading Romania's rating to junk status is on a knife-edge amid ongoing political crisis, with implications for country's creditworthiness and economic stability.

items.title: STAT+: Hims misled consumers and violated their privacy, FTC alleges in a lawsuit
items.snippet: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission sued telehealth company Hims & Hers alleging business practices that agency says misled consumers.
items.line: FTC sues Hims & Hers for misleading consumers about privacy and billing practices, signaling increased regulatory scrutiny of telehealth companies' data handling.

items.title: Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic more than ever
items.snippet: Microsoft pitched its own homegrown AI models, harnesses, and even a Mythos competitor on Wednesday, telling Wall Street it plans for continued growth.
items.line: Microsoft is openly pitching homegrown AI models and agents as direct competition to OpenAI and Anthropic, marking shift from partnership to rivalry in enterprise AI market.

items.title: US government bans new foreign-made humanoids, robot dogs, and solar inverters, citing risks to national security
items.snippet: The ban largely affects U.S. imports from China, which currently dominates the global market for making humanoid robots and solar inverters.
items.line: US government bans foreign-made humanoids, robot dogs, and solar inverters citing national security risks, primarily targeting Chinese dominance in robotics and clean energy hardware.

items.line: Healthcare workers' nationwide strike over salary disputes and alleged legislation-based pay cuts demonstrates systemic tensions in Romania's medical sector reform efforts.

items.title: CMS ending Medicare Part D subsidy program
items.snippet: The Trump administration announced that it will end a subsidy program that aimed to keep premiums low for Medicare Part D beneficiaries.
items.line: Trump administration ends Medicare Part D subsidy program that kept drug premiums low, directly raising costs for millions of seniors on fixed incomes.

items.title: Salesforce lands $1.6B Veteran Affairs deal to integrate AI into healthcare workflows
items.snippet: The agreement aims to create a “unified foundation across the department, equipping VA employees with trusted agentic AI, integrated data, and advanced collaboration tools that can reduce administrative friction and give staff more time to serve Veterans," the VA said.
items.line: Salesforce wins $1.6B VA deal to integrate AI into healthcare workflows, demonstrating government's commitment to using agents to reduce administrative burden on healthcare workers.

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg predicts that billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years
items.snippet: As Meta pours billions into AI infrastructure and agents, Zuckerberg is working to convince investors that the payoff will be worth the price.
items.line: Zuckerberg predicts billions of people will have personal AI agents within five years as Meta pours billions into infrastructure to compete in enterprise and consumer AI.

items.title: Apple faces bipartisan Senate pushback over plans to buy Chinese memory chips
items.snippet: Bloomberg reports that US senators from both sides of the aisle are urging Apple CEO Tim Cook to commit by August 21 to not using memory chips from Chinese suppliers CXMT and YMTC. Here are the details.
items.line: Bipartisan Senate pressure on Apple CEO to commit by August 21 to avoiding Chinese memory chips signals geopolitical supply chain concerns and potential national security restrictions.

items.title: Apple pushes back against UK proposal to loosen App Store payment rules
items.snippet: Apple today alleged that a new UK proposal targeting App Store fees amounts to price regulation, warning that it could undermine innovation and investment. Here are the details.
items.line: Apple warns UK regulators that proposed App Store payment rules amount to price regulation that could undermine innovation, escalating confrontation over digital marketplace control.

items.title: Peste 1.000 de angajaţi în domeniul AI lansează un apel privind dezvoltarea inteligenţei artificiale: „Există un risc real”
items.snippet: Peste 1.000 de angajaţi ai unor companii de top din domeniul inteligenţei artificiale (AI) au semnat o scrisoare deschisă prin care cer măsuri de siguranţă care ar permite încetinirea avansului rapid al AI dacă va fi necesar, avertizând că tehnologia ar putea depăşi capacitatea umană de a o înţelege
items.line: Over 1,100 AI industry employees including company directors call for government measures to slow advanced AI development, warning technology risks becoming uncontrollable.
